results.name: Counterexample satisfies the backlog accounting identity
The methodology does not categorically rule out cooling demand
Partial survey updates preserve both observation periods in the headline
The vendor horizon clause includes its own observation or statement date
A single survey retains its original quarter in the headline
A zero year-ago unfilled-order balance does not abort backlog_months
The base computes valid backlog ratios for the same zero-base fixture
The publisher ages the JLL benchmark to stale on April 1, 2027
The displayed benchmark communicates its published stale status
A stale package lead-time row already carries a stale badge
Fresh, mixed-period and aged fixtures satisfy the schema

diagnostics.agedBenchmark: 5 packages cover 50% of the DC Build index. Lead time is a stated survey average or a vendor's order horizon, dated to the period it measures; across all data-center equipment the US average is 42 wk ( JLL 2026 Global Data Center Outlook (Jan 6, 2026) ); price is the component's PPI at its own last reading; industry backlog is Census M3 months of unfilled orders, and switchgear and transformers share one industry group; vendor figures are what each company states, never summed across bases.
